name: Risk Assessment
definition: Queries regarding the safety or risk level of specific locations, activities, or behaviors (e.g., beaches, travel, moving around freely).

name: Case Statistics
definition: Requests for quantitative data regarding COVID-19 cases, deaths, recoveries, or other stats for specific regions or globally.

name: Donation
definition: User intents expressing a desire to donate money or support to organizations, countries, or groups affected by the pandemic.

name: Prevention
definition: Queries seeking advice or methods to stay safe, avoid infection, or stop the spread (e.g., gloves, masks, tips).

name: Transmission
definition: Questions about how the virus spreads, including specific vectors, materials, or interactions (e.g., kissing, surfaces, animals).

name: Treatments & Cures
definition: Queries regarding medical treatments, vaccines, medicines, or procedures to cure or treat COVID-19.

name: News Updates
definition: Requests for current news, general updates, or headlines regarding the status of the virus.

name: General Information
definition: Broad questions asking for a description, definition, or general information about the coronavirus itself.

name: Symptoms
definition: Questions specifically asking about the symptoms of COVID-19.

name: Animals & Pets
definition: Questions regarding the transmission, infection, or safety of pets and animals in relation to COVID-19.

name: Greetings & Gratitude
definition: Utterances consisting of greetings, thanks, or appreciation directed at the bot.

name: Bot Capability Inquiry
definition: Questions asking what the bot knows, what information it can provide, or what services it offers.

name: Social Sharing
definition: Requests to share information or content on social media platforms or stories.

name: Travel Advice
definition: User intent regarding travel restrictions, safety of travel modes, or advice on cancelling or proceeding with trips.

name: Misinformation
definition: User intent to verify or ask about rumors, myths, conspiracy theories, or unverified claims regarding the virus's origin or nature.

name: Testing
definition: User intent to inquire about medical screening, checking for symptoms to diagnose the disease, or testing procedures.
